 The Blue Mask Hailey Bieber Wore in Korea

 By PAP Magazine Editorial
 TL;DR 
 Hailey Bieber's Pyderin sheet mask from her Korea trip became a hot topic. Pyderin is a Korean brand centered on PDRN, an ingredient that soothes skin and builds elasticity.

 Hailey Bieber's Pyderin sheet mask from her Korea trip became a hot topic. Pyderin is a Korean brand centered on PDRN, an ingredient that soothes skin and builds elasticity.
PDRN stands for Polydeoxyribonucleotide, a compound that repairs damaged skin cells and improves firmness. Because it handles professional-grade ingredients, Pyderin products are sold mainly in pharmacies and skin clinics. The mask Hailey used is the Hydrovuster PDRN SOS Hya Soothing Mask. It floods parched skin with moisture through ten types of hyaluronic acid and helps slack skin feel firm again.
Beyond the mask, Pyderin offers a facial lift line and cream products. Hailey applied a Pyderin cream to her neck while wearing the mask. It's a pairing that covers both hydration and firmness in one go, targeting texture and glow at the same time.
Pyderin products are available on the brand's official online store and in offline locations. You can also find them in pharmacies and dermatology clinics. Ready to chase that Hailey glow yourself?

 FAQ
 What blue sheet mask did Hailey Bieber use in Korea? 
 It's the Feederine Hydrobooster PDRN SOS Hyal Soothing Mask. Ten types of hyaluronic acid deliver deep hydration, while PDRN helps improve elasticity. Feederine is a Korean brand primarily sold at pharmacies and dermatology clinics.
 What is PDRN? 
 PDRN stands for Polydeoxyribonucleotide, a clinical ingredient used to repair damaged skin cells and boost elasticity. Known for its soothing and regenerative effects, it's commonly found in pharmacy and clinic-grade skincare products.
 Where can I buy Feederine products? 
 Feederine is available through the official online store, pharmacies, and dermatology clinics. As a brand that works with clinical-grade ingredients, its offline presence is concentrated in pharmacies and professional skin clinics.
